svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: claudex — what each mode does
svg.desc: The 15 first-class modes plus 1 optional one, grouped by job, each with a one-line description and its verdict labels. Groups: framing, truth/evidence, critique, solution, robustness, decision, change-risk, trim, heavy, optional.
svg.text: claudex — what each mode does
15 first-class modes + 1 optional, grouped by job.
framing — setup
Doesn't solve the task — checks its setup: boundaries, inputs,done-criteria. Returns up to 5 clarifying questions.
truth / evidence
Checks facts, numbers, dates, versions against the real world.Each: VERIFIED / WRONG / UNVERIFIABLE, with a source.
Does the conclusion follow from the attached data?SUPPORTED / OVERSTATED / UNSUPPORTED + a corrected wording.
Checks an artifact against rules / brief / spec.VIOLATION / OK / UNCLEAR with a quote of the rule.
critique
Adversarial — refutes the thesis. First line VERDICT: SOUNDor CONTESTED, then material objections with reasoning.
Builds the strongest case FOR the idea before rejecting it.
Hidden assumptions & framing bias: sunk_cost, false_dichotomy,loaded_framing, selection_bias — plus a neutral reframe.
solution
Solves from scratch, unseen. Claude then diffs the answers:matched / only-Claude / only-Codex / conflict.
Already solved? Libraries, patterns, tools, articles —what each covers and what's missing.
robustness
The cheapest verification plan: 2-4 steps that try tofalsify fast. branch_cut + cost for each.
Threat model: assets, attackers, abuse-paths, injection,privacy leaks — with a concrete defense for each.
decision
Compares two finished artifacts, A vs B. WINNER + why,and what to take from the loser.
change-risk
Assume the plan failed in 6 months. Failure modes bylikelihood + early_signal + a cheap near-term hedge.
trim
Cuts bloat (YAGNI, duplication, ornament). A 'cut' list:what and why, with an estimated % reduction.
heavy — whole folder
Hands a whole folder to Codex — it greps/reads the tree itselfand fans out its own parallel subagents. Read-only; spot-check counts.
optional — on demand
Critique & rewrite a prompt: ambiguities, missing context,vague output format. Returns a better version + edits.
blind — Codex doesn't see Claude's answer · web — web search on · default — runs when no mode is given
